scientific_integrity: The claim separates a proved method-relative minimum from the stronger global questions that remain open; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Optimality is only within the Egrot–Hirsch modified-rainbow parameter scheme under the published depth-equivalence criterion; no global minimality claim is made for all finite relation algebras or all rainbow constructions.
title: Egrot–Hirsch rainbow witnesses are size-optimal within their depth-equivalence scheme
